name: rheon-sort
description: Sorts Rheon records by the value of one field -- sort -n for records.
notes:
Sorts Rheon records by the value of one field -- sort -n for records. Numbers as numbers, strings as strings; records without the field go last and are counted on stderr. Passes the records through unchanged.

Prototype for #58 (2026-10-13); promoted to Rust in #78 (2026-10-14), with the Python version kept as the diff-test reference. Accumulates its input like sort, keeping only each line and the value it is sorted by (#92). Reads on up to four threads and hands the records on in input order, so the answer is the same at any number; RHEON_THREADS=N sets the number (1 reads on one thread) (#92). With hsh's HSH_RHEON=sig (exit not unwrapped), this is what makes `du | sort -n` composable while the records stay records.
